vraivelo.title: Our Story
vraivelo.subtitle: Born from a passion for cycling and craftsmanship, Vraivélo is more than just a bike shop.

how_it_started.title: How It Started
how_it_started.text: Vraivélo began in a small garage with a simple idea: that every bicycle tells a story. What started as a weekend hobby of restoring vintage frames quickly evolved into a full-scale dedication to the art of cycling. We realized that there was a gap between modern mass-produced bikes and the soulful machines of the past. Our journey is about bridging that gap, bringing artisanal care to modern performance.

who_we_are.title: Who We Are
who_we_are.text: We are a team of cyclists, mechanics, and designers united by our love for two wheels.

what_we_do.title: What We Do
what_we_do.text: At Vraivélo, we specialize in breathing new life into classic frames and building custom bicycles that turn heads. From full vintage restorations to modern custom builds, we handle every detail with precision. We also offer expert maintenance services, ensuring your ride is always smooth and safe. We believe in sustainable cycling, reusing quality components where possible, and promoting a cycling culture that values quality over quantity.

services.title: Basic Tune-up
services.description: Ideal for regular maintenance and safe riding.
features: Cleaning and lubrication: We leave the bike spotless and ready to roll.
Health check: We check the remaining life of your parts (chain, pads, etc.).
General adjustment: We tune up brakes, gears, and headset.
Safety torque: We check all bolts with the exact recommended pressure.

services.title: Full Overhaul
services.description: The star option to make your bike feel like new.
features: Internal maintenance: We dismantle and grease bottom bracket and headset to eliminate noises.
Perfect wheels: We check and adjust spoke tension so wheels spin true.
Chain treatment: We apply professional wax for smoother shifting and longer drivetrain life.
